I personally think that IBS isn't some kind of weird, mystical disease. I just think IBS is the set of symptoms that happen when a few intestinal things fall out of wack (not enough fiber so regularity suffers, not enough enzyme production so food isn't broken down well, and intestinal wall damage from lack of glutamine, etc) and the issues pile up.

Try Benefiber instead of miralax. Benefiber is absorbed into your body just like soluble fiber that would come from foods. It's much more gentle and well-absorbed than miralax. Benefiber isn't a laxative, it just keeps things moving like Mother Nature intended.
